loading.description: Loading spinner message while fetching book list

emptyLibraryTitle.description: Title of the empty state when the library has no books at all

emptyLibraryBody.description: Body of the empty-library state, pointing to scanning

emptyLibraryAction.description: Button of the empty-library state; goes to the Scan tab

emptyFilter.wishlisted.description: Title when the 'wishlisted' status chip has no books, a full sentence in the status's own wording (not built from the status label), e.g. 'Nothing marked wishlisted yet'. Mind noun case and grammar per language.

emptyFilter.purchased.description: Title when the 'purchased' status chip has no books, a full sentence in the status's own wording (not built from the status label), e.g. 'Nothing marked purchased yet'. Mind noun case and grammar per language.

emptyFilter.reading.description: Title when the 'reading' status chip has no books, a full sentence in the status's own wording (not built from the status label), e.g. 'Nothing marked reading yet'. Mind noun case and grammar per language.

emptyFilter.read.description: Title when the 'read' status chip has no books, a full sentence in the status's own wording (not built from the status label), e.g. 'Nothing marked read yet'. Mind noun case and grammar per language.

emptyFilterBody.description: Body of the empty status-filter state

emptyFilterAction.description: Button of the empty status-filter state; switches back to All

emptySearchTitle.description: Title when the search matches no book. {{query}} is what the user typed.

emptySearchAction.description: Button of the no-search-match state; clears the search field

loadErrorAction.description: Button of the failed-load state in My Books; reloads the list

statusTab.all.description: Filter tab label showing all books regardless of status

statusTab.wishlisted.description: Filter tab label for wishlisted books

statusTab.purchased.description: Filter tab label for purchased books

statusTab.reading.description: Filter tab label for books currently being read

statusTab.read.description: Filter tab label for finished books

status.wishlisted.description: Display badge label for wishlisted status

status.purchased.description: Display badge label for purchased status

status.reading.description: Display badge label for currently reading status

status.read.description: Display badge label for finished/read status

filterBy.description: Accessibility label of a status chip, e.g. 'Filter by Reading, 2 books'. Plural: _one/_other (and locale categories). {{count}} is the chip count. {{label}} is the chip name.

bookCardA11y.description: Accessibility label for a library row: title, translated status, then the author

bookCardUnverifiedA11y.description: Accessibility label for the row of an unverified book (one the user added themselves, #616): title, translated status, author, then that it is unverified

bookCardHint.description: Accessibility hint for a book card — tells the user what tapping does

moreOptionsA11y.description: Accessibility label of the ⋯ button at the end of a My Books row; opens that book's actions

actions.viewDetails.description: Row in the book actions sheet that opens the book detail sheet

actions.remove.description: Destructive row in the book actions sheet that moves the book to Trash

actions.close.description: Close button of the book actions sheet (visible and spoken)

rowMeta.description: Meta line of a library row: the status and the publication year, joined with a middle dot

markAs.description: Button label to advance a book to the next reading status, e.g. 'Mark as Reading'

markAsA11y.description: Accessibility label for the mark-as button

removeFromList.description: Button label to remove a book from the user's list

removeBookA11y.description: Accessibility label for the remove button, includes book title

closeDetail.description: Accessibility label for the close button on the book detail sheet

errorLoadBooks.description: Error message when the book list fails to load

errorUpdateStatus.description: Error message when updating book status fails

errorRemoveBook.description: Error message when removing a book fails

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text inside the My Books search field (title or author)

searchA11y.description: Accessibility label for the My Books search input

searchClearA11y.description: Accessibility label of the search field's clear button

screenTitle.description: Serif screen title of My Books

headerBooks.description: Header subtitle part: how many books are in the library. Plural: _one/_other (and locale categories). {{count}} is the number.

headerReading.description: Header subtitle part: how many books are being read now, e.g. '2 reading now'. Left out when 0. Plural: _one/_other (and locale categories). {{count}} is the number.

headerSubtitle.description: Header subtitle joining the two parts, e.g. '10 books · 2 reading now'

section.readingNow.description: Section label above the shelf of books being read now (shown uppercase)

section.allBooks.description: Section label above the full list of books (shown uppercase)

sort.sheetTitle.description: Title of the sort sheet, e.g. 'Sort by'

sort.buttonA11y.description: Accessibility label of the Sort icon button; {{label}} is the current sort option name (the sort.added/title/author text)

sort.added.description: Sort option and current-sort caption: newest additions first, e.g. 'Recently added'

sort.title.description: Sort option: alphabetical by title, e.g. 'Title A–Z'. Use the locale's own alphabet order wording.

sort.author.description: Sort option: alphabetical by author, e.g. 'Author A–Z'. Use the locale's own alphabet order wording.

view.showGrid.description: Accessibility label of the My Books header button that switches the list to a grid of covers. Shown while the list is active; an action, e.g. 'Show as grid'.

view.showList.description: Accessibility label of the My Books header button that switches the grid back to the list. Shown while the grid is active; an action, e.g. 'Show as list'.

shelfA11y.description: Accessibility label of the 'Reading now' shelf, announced as a list, e.g. 'Reading now, 2 books'. Plural: _one/_other (and locale categories). {{count}} is the number of books.

shelfItemA11y.description: Accessibility label of a book on the 'Reading now' shelf, e.g. 'Dune, by Frank Herbert'

movedToTrash.description: Banner after a library entry is moved to the trash; says it can be restored within 30 days

viewTrash.description: Banner action button that opens the Trash screen

trash.back.description: Back button on the Trash screen

trash.loading.description: Loading spinner message on the Trash screen

trash.intro.description: Info card text on the Trash screen: the 30-day rule

trash.emptyTitle.description: Empty state heading when the trash has no entries

trash.emptyBody.description: Empty state explanation of the 30-day rule

trash.purgeIn.description: Days-left line on a trashed book row. Plural: _one/_other (and locale categories). {{count}} is the number of whole days until it is deleted for good.

trash.purgeToday.description: Days-left line on a trashed book row when it is deleted for good today

trash.rowA11y.description: Screen-reader label of a Trash row: title, author, and the days-left line (when)

trash.rowUnverifiedA11y.description: Screen-reader label of a Trash row for a book the user added themselves: title, author, days left (when, may be empty) and that it is unverified

trash.restore.description: Button that restores a trashed book to the library

trash.restoreA11y.description: Screen-reader label for the Restore button; title is the book title

trash.restored.description: Banner after a book is restored; title is the book title

trash.restoreConflict.description: Error when restoring a book that already has a live library entry

trash.restoreNotFound.description: Error when the book is no longer in the trash; the list reloads

trash.restoreFailed.description: Generic error when restoring a book fails

trash.errorLoad.description: Error shown when the trash list cannot be loaded

trash.retry.description: Retry button after the trash list fails to load

trash.errorRefresh.description: Error banner when refreshing the trash list fails while entries are shown
